universal_patterns.pattern: applicable to the professions and vocations required by law to be regulated

proposal.rationale: Hawaii's Title 25 Chapter 436B is the Uniform Professional and Vocational Licensing Act. Section 436B-3(a) explicitly limits the chapter to "professions and vocations required by law to be regulated by the licensing authority" (the DCCA director or boards under DCCA). This is NOT a universal "all occupations in the state" pattern — it is scoped to DCCA-regulated professions. However, within that scope it applies to every such profession, so we treat it as chapter-universal via "as used in this chapter" combined with the applicability language. Chapter 451D-2 enumerates practice acts via "licensed pursuant to chapter NNN". Hawaii chapter tokens can include letter suffixes (e.g., 436B, 436E, 463E). Section cites use the form "section 436B-3" where the chapter token is before the dash.
